Prepare data from a databook for uploading to database

Source: R/database_prepare_data.R
databasePrepareData.Rd

Prepares the data contained in a databook object for upload and writes it to the database. This includes adding the source ETL script script_id and, when applicable, resolving source_id values to participant_id values and event_id using the id_mapping table.

Usage

databasePrepareData(databook, script_id, con = NULL)

Arguments

databook

A list as generated by sourceScript(). Must contain at least:

  • $data: A data frame with the table to upload.

  • $codebook_name: Character; target table name in the database.

  • $codebook_version: Character; version identifier for the codebook.

script_id

Character. Both the identifier and file path of the ETL script; read to compute the MD5 hash.

con

A DBI connection. If NULL, the default connection set by FAIRgroundConnect() is used.

Value

TRUE if data was successfully pushed and table_script updated, FALSE otherwise.

Details

Special handling is applied depending on databook$codebook_name:

  • "id_mapping": Adds a deterministic participant_id column via .addParticipantIds().

  • Other tables: If the data contains a source_id column, the function joins against the database id_mapping table to add participant_id. The source_id column is then set to NA.

  • Other tables without source_id: if participant_id is already present in the data it is used directly; this is logged at info level.

If the data is successfully uploaded to the database, table_script is also updated with metadata for that script_id, including the MD5 hash of the ETL script and the codebook version.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
FAIRgroundConnect("LUCID_FAIRPOINT_TEST")
script_id <- "studies/LaCHMI/scripts/participant.R"
databook <- sourceScript(script_id = script_id)
databasePrepareData(databook, script_id = script_id)
} # }
